## Result

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `flutter gen-l10n` leaves `untranslated.json` empty
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] Android emulator or device test when alarm behavior changes
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes

## Safety

- [ ] No keystore, `key.properties`, token, personal backup or private data is included
- [ ] Existing alarms and backups remain compatible
- [ ] Permission, battery and Direct Boot effects are documented
